# Modules
```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(readxl)
```

# Load diet Xenium objects
```{r}
xen1diet <- readRDS("D:/USERS/ELLIOT/Dissertation/xen1/Diet_obj_for_Pseudotime.rds")

xen2diet <- readRDS("D:/USERS/ELLIOT/Dissertation/xen2/Diet_obj_for_Pseudotime.rds")
```

# Add Xen2 cell type annotations
```{r}
xen2cell_type <- read_excel("D:/USERS/ELLIOT/Dissertation/xen2/Xen2_cluster_names 1.xlsx")

# Map cluster IDs to biological annotations
cluster_map <- setNames(
  xen2cell_type$name,
  xen2cell_type$group
)

# Add annotations as Seurat metadata
xen2diet$cell_type <- unname(
  cluster_map[
    as.character(xen2diet$seurat_clusters)
  ]
)
```

# Load ROI extraction
```{r}
roi_objects <- readRDS(file = "results/objects/Xen2_WT_Vessels_roi_objects.rds")
```
